sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We understand that the cost increases you outlined put pressure on your pricing, and appreciate the need for a formal approval process for larger price steps. We can commit to the volume stated below, and our rising forecast and the longer contract term we offer provide planning security. Since price cuts are currently frozen, could you consider moving the other terms to support a stable renewal?

We confirm a binding volume of 4580 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10, po:4500014417-10, po:4500014351-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 419.78 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, 4580 units a year.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the price history and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

We acknowledge your verified volume forecast and appreciate the planning security provided by a 36-month contract. Although our flexibility on price is currently constrained, the extended contract term enables us to offer EUR 432.15 per unit. To accommodate this adjustment, we request a payment term of 60 days net instead of the proposed 90 days.

Our current offer is a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: a price of €430.68 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
